title.rendered: Lubo AWS StarScreen Sorting C&D Waste

content.rendered:
The Lubo Neptunus is shown here sorting C&D debris. As a mobile screening solution with extremely high throughput capacity, the Neptunus is also ideally suited for cost-efficient processing of materials such as compost, asphalt, clay, sludge, soil, and kiln slag.

The Lubo Neptunus is shown here sorting C&D debris. VAN DYK provides exclusive sales and service for Lubo products, including the Neptunus. As a mobile screening solution with extremely high throughput capacity, the Neptunus is also ideally suited for cost-efficient processing of materials such as compost, asphalt, clay, sludge, soil, and kiln slag.
